G4200.et: from a derivative of poros (a way, i.e. means)
G4200.def: from a derivative of poros (a way, i.e. means); furnishing (procuring), i.e. (by implication) money-getting (acquisition):--gain.

G4201.def: of Latin origin; apparently swinish; Porcius, a Roman:--Porcius.

G4202.def: from «4203»; harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry:--fornication.

G4203.def: from «4204»; to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry:--commit (fornication).

G4204.def: feminine of «4205»; a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater:--harlot, whore.

G4205.et: from pernemi (to sell, akin to the base of (4097))
G4205.def: from pernemi (to sell; akin to the base of «4097»); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine):--fornicator, whoremonger.

G4206.def: adverb from «4253»; forwards, i.e. at a distance:--far, a great way off. See also «4207».

G4207.et: from (4206) with adverbial enclitic of source
G4207.def: from «4206» with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly:--afar off.

G4208.def: adverb comparative of «4206»; further, i.e. a greater distance:--farther.

G4209.def: of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it:--purple.

G4211.def: feminine of a compound of «4209» and «4453»; a female trader in purple cloth:--seller of purple.

G4212.def: multiplicative from «4214»; how many times:--how oft(-en).

G4213.def: from the alternate of «4095»; a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught:--drink.

G4214.et: from an absolute pos (who, what) and (3739)
G4214.def: from an absolute pos (who, what) and «3739»; interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many):--how great (long, many), what.

G4215.et: probably from a derivative of the alternate of (4095) (cf (4224))
G4215.def: probably from a derivative of the alternate of «4095» (compare «4224»); a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water:--flood, river, stream, water.

G4216.def: from «4215» and a derivative of «5409»; river-borne, i.e. overwhelmed by a stream:--carried away of the flood.

G4217.et: apparently from (4219) and the base of (4226)
G4217.def: apparently from «4219» and the base of «4226»; interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort:--what (manner of).

G4218.pos: 1. once i.e. formerly, aforetime, at some time
G4218.def: from the base of «4225» and «5037»; indefinite adverb, at some time, ever:--afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n- )ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when.

G4219.def: from the base of «4226» and «5037»; interrogative adverb, at what time:--+ how long, when.

G4220.et: neuter of a comparative of the base of (4226)
G4220.def: neuter of a comparative of the base of «4226»; interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that:--whether.

G4221.et: of a derivative of the alternate of (4095)
G4221.def: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of «4095»; a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate:--cup.

G4222.et: from a derivative of the alternate of (4095)
G4222.def: from a derivative of the alternate of «4095»; to furnish drink, irrigate:--give (make) to drink, feed, water.

G4223.def: of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy:--Puteoli.

G4224.def: from the alternate of «4095»; a drinking-bout or carousal:--banqueting.

G4225.et: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun pos (some) otherwise obsolete (cf (4214))
G4225.def: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun pos (some) otherwise obsolete (compare «4214»); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly:--about, a certain place.

G4226.et: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun pos (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as (4225) used with the rising slide of enquiry)
G4226.def: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun pos (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as «4225» used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality:--where, whither.

G4227.def: of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian:--Pudens.

G4228.def: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally):--foot(-stool).

G4229.def: from «4238»; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material):--business, matter, thing, work.

G4231.def: from «4229»; to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade:--occupy.

G4232.def: of Latin origin; the praetorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp):--(common, judgment) hall (of judgment), palace, praetorium.

G4233.def: from a derivative of «4238»; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector:--officer.

G4234.def: from «4238»; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function:--deed, office, work.

G4235.et: a form of (4239), used in certain parts
G4235.def: a form of «4239», used in certain parts; gentle, i.e. humble:--meek.

G4237.et: perhaps from prason (a leek, and so an onion-patch)
G4237.def: perhaps from prason (a leek, and so an onion-patch); a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement):--in ranks.

G4238.def: a primary verb; to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from «4160», which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally):--commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts.

G4239.def: apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble:--meek. See also «4235».

G4241.def: apparently a primary verb; to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right):--become, comely.

G4242.def: from «4243»; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors):--ambassage, message.

G4243.def: from the base of «4245»; to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher):--be an ambassador.

G4244.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «4245»; the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery":--(estate of) elder(-s), presbytery.

G4245.def: comparative of presbus (elderly); older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter":-- elder(-est), old.

G4246.def: from the same as «4245»; an old man:--aged (man), old man.

G4247.def: feminine of «4246»; an old woman:--aged woman.

G4248.def: from «4253»; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head foremost:--headlong.

G4249.et: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw)
G4249.def: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw); to saw in two:--saw asunder.

G4251.def: of Latin origin; feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian woman:--Prisca. See also «4252».

G4252.def: diminutive of «4251»; Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian woman:--Priscilla.

G4253.def: a primary preposition; "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to:--above, ago, before, or ever. In the comparative, it retains the same significations.

G4254.def: from «4253» and «71»; to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous)):--bring (forth, out), go before.

G4255.def: from «4253» and «138»; to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend):--purpose.

G4256.def: from «4253» and a derivative of «156»; to accuse already, i.e. previously charge:--prove before.

G4257.def: from «4253» and «191»; to hear already,i.e. anticipate:--hear before.

G4258.def: from «4253» and «264»; to sin previously (to conversion):--sin already, heretofore sin.

G4259.et: from a presumed compound of (4253) and (833)
G4259.def: neuter of a presumed compound of «4253» and «833»; a forecourt, i.e. vestibule (alley-way):--porch.

G4260.def: from «4253» and the base of «939»; to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years):--+ be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken.

G4261.def: from «4253» and «906»; to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate:--put forward, shoot forth.

G4262.def: from «4263»; relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem:--sheep (market).

G4263.et: probably from a presumed. derivative of (4260)
G4263.def: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of «4260»; something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively):--sheep(-fold).

G4264.et: from (4253) and a reduplicated form of (971)
G4264.def: from «4253» and a reduplicated form of «971»; to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate:--draw, before instruct.

G4265.def: from «4253» and «991»; to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance:--provide.

G4266.def: from «4253» and «1096»; to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired:--be past.

G4267.def: from «4253» and «1097»; to know beforehand, i.e. foresee:--foreknow (ordain), know (before).

G4270.def: from «4253» and «1125»; to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe:--before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime).

G4271.def: from «4253» and «1212»; plain before all men, i.e. obvious:--evident, manifest (open) beforehand.

G4272.def: from «4253» and «1325»; to give before the other party has given:--first give.

G4273.et: from (4272) (in the sense of giving forward into another's [the enemy's] hands)
G4273.def: from «4272» (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands); a surrender:--betrayer, traitor.

G4274.def: from the alternate of «4390»; a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor):--forerunner.

G4276.def: from «4253» and «1679»; to hope in advance of other confirmation:--first trust.

G4277.pos:
1. to say before
    1. to say in what precedes, to say above
    2. to say before i.e. heretofore, formerly
    3. to say beforehand i.e. before the event: prophecies
G4277.def: from «4253» and «2036»; to say already, to predict:--forewarn, say (speak, tell) before. Compare «4280».

G4279.def: middle voice from «4253» and «1861»; to promise of old:--promise before.

G4280.et: from (4253) and (2046), used as alternate of (4277)
G4280.def: from «4253» and «2046»; used as alternate of «4277»; to say already, predict:--foretell, say (speak, tell) before.

G4281.def: from «4253» and «2064» (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time):--go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.

G4282.def: from «4253» and «2090»; to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively):--ordain before, prepare afore.

G4283.def: middle voice from «4253» and «2097»; to announce glad news in advance:--preach before the gospel.

G4284.def: middle voice from «4253» and «2192»; to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel:--be better.

G4285.def: from «4253» and «2233»; to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference:--prefer.

G4286.def: from «4388»; a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God:--purpose, shew(-bread).

G4287.def: from «4253» and a derivative of «5087»; fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with «2250» implied) a designated day:--time appointed.

G4288.def: from «4289»; predisposition, i.e. alacrity:--forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.

G4289.def: from «4253» and «2372»; forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity:--ready, willing.

G4291.def: from «4253» and «2476»; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise:--maintain, be over, rule.

G4292.def: middle voice from «4253» and «2564»; to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate:--provoke.

G4293.def: from «4253» and «2605»; to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise:--foretell, have notice, (shew) before.

G4294.def: from «4253» and «2675»; to prepare in advance:--make up beforehand.

G4295.def: from «4253» and «2749»; to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward):--be first, set before (forth).

G4296.def: from «4253» and «2784»; to herald (i.e. proclaim) in advance:--before (first) preach.

G4297.def: from «4298»; progress, i.e. advancement (subjectively or objectively):--furtherance, profit.

G4298.def: from «4253» and «2875»; to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along):--increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.

G4299.def: from a compound of «4253» and «2919»; a prejudgment (prejudice), i.e. prepossession:--prefer one before another.
